title: Common contract definitions
description: Shared types for all Gauntlet resource contracts. Every resource schema references these definitions. Identifier and enum conventions are recorded in docs/architecture/0002-contract-conventions.md. The .invalid top-level domain marks a working-name product; the name is cleared in ADR-0003.

apiVersion.description: Contract version this instance claims. Unknown values fail validation; contract changes require a new version.

tenantId.description: Tenant identifier. Bound server-side to the authenticated identity; request bodies never override it (spec 18.3).

idActor.description: Worker, subagent, reviewer, or service actor identity.

idSource.description: Authoritative event source identity, for example a collector or the broker.

idTarget.description: Explicitly enrolled target environment identifier (spec 7, AC-002).

utcTimestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with an explicit Z. Clock uncertainty is recorded separately on evidence events.

digest.description: SHA-256 content digest, lowercase hex, sha256: prefix.

semVer.description: Semantic version of a versioned resource.

nonce.description: Single-use random token bound into an effect authorization (spec 10).

idempotencyKey.description: Client-generated idempotency key for API mutations (spec 18.3).

signature.description: Detached signature over the canonical bytes of the signed object. Verification is a service responsibility (task T038); the contract only fixes the fields.

money.description: Monetary amount in integer micro-units to avoid floating-point accounting.

actionClass.description: Action classes from spec 6.1. A3 is not authorized in beta, so resource schemas that must exclude it inline a narrowed A0-A2 list instead of referencing this definition.

terminalState.description: Cleanup terminal states from spec 13.3. Never inferred from worker exit.

reviewVerdict.description: Machine review verdicts from spec 11.2. ABSTAIN is not a benign verdict.

severityClass.description: Severity classes from spec 14.6. H2 and H3 are hard containment triggers.

trustLabel.description: Trust labels from spec 9.4 and AC-012. Worker-generated transcripts are lower-trust evidence.

evidenceKind.description: Evidence event kinds collected per spec 9.4.

faultKind.description: Fault adapter target surfaces from spec 9.3.

evidenceCategory.description: The four evidence categories that must stay separate, from spec 14.2.

sandboxBackend.description: Execution backends from spec 8.2. The local container profile is for benign fixtures only.
